snippet.title: Photomaly Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Photomaly is a PSX-style FPS horror/thriller where you take over the photo studio your father left behind. Take portraits for customers, process their orders, and deliver the correct prints.

Play the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4309160/Photomaly_Demo

Play the demo on Itch io: https://enesturaldev.itch.io/photomaly

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4286120/Photomaly/
